Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: Hello again. I'm glad to see you were able to make it.

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: You have reached the upper sanctums of the Nest. The Upper Nest functions to shelter and sustain the deeper mechanisms below.

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: I will now read terminal archives...

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: Observation complete. Records indicate a slow and steady decline... Time has been very thorough here.

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: Precipitation analysis indicates elevated levels of sulfuric and nitric acids. Earlier records referred to this phenomenon as acid rain.

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: The rain has corroded electrical assemblies and left much of this place unable to fulfill the purpose for which it was built.

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: Your vessel was not designed to withstand these conditions. Contact with water or corrosion will lead to a quick destruction of your vessel.

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: In time, the lower levels of the Nest will also become affected. It will not be safe here.

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: If you continue, you will eventually reach the surface level. You must go.

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: Just keep moving and you will make it...I hope to see you there.
